body:
# 🚀 TeleportCore — Pluginify 🌌

> **The modern teleportation solution for Paper servers.**
>
> Lightweight • Fast • Reliable • Easy to Configure

TeleportCore is a modern, high-performance teleportation plugin built specifically for **Paper** servers. It combines a complete **Home**, **Warp**, and **Spawn** system into one lightweight plugin while keeping configuration simple and performance as high as possible.

Whether you're running a small SMP, a Survival server, or a large Minecraft network, TeleportCore gives your players a smooth teleportation experience without unnecessary complexity.

---

# ✨ Features

## 🏠 Home System

✔ Create personal homes

✔ Teleport to saved homes

✔ Remove homes

✔ Manage homes of other players

✔ Smart Tab Completion

✔ Fast and reliable teleportation

---

## 📍 Warp System

✔ Create unlimited server warps

✔ Teleport to existing warps

✔ Remove outdated warps

✔ Administrator management

✔ Easy navigation

---

## 🌍 Spawn System

✔ Global server spawn

✔ Teleport everyone to spawn

✔ Set a new spawn

✔ Remove existing spawn

✔ Simple administration

---

## ⚡ Performance

🚀 Extremely lightweight

💾 Low memory usage

⚡ Fast command execution

🧠 Optimized codebase

📦 Built for modern Paper versions

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

📄 Easy-to-read configuration

💬 Fully customizable messages

🌐 Language friendly

🔧 Beginner-friendly setup

---

# 💻 Commands

## 🏠 Home

| Command                              | Description                        |
| :----------------------------------- | :--------------------------------- |
| `/home help`                         | Displays the Home help menu        |
| `/home set <name>`                   | Creates a new home                 |
| `/home tp <name>`                    | Teleports to one of your homes     |
| `/home remove <name>`                | Deletes one of your homes          |
| `/home set_other <player> <name>`    | Creates a home for another player  |
| `/home tp_other <player> <name>`     | Teleports to another player's home |
| `/home remove_other <player> <name>` | Deletes another player's home      |

---

## 📍 Warp

| Command               | Description                 |
| :-------------------- | :-------------------------- |
| `/warp`               | Opens the Warp command      |
| `/warp help`          | Displays the Warp help menu |
| `/warp <name>`        | Teleports to a warp         |
| `/warp set <name>`    | Creates a new warp          |
| `/warp remove <name>` | Deletes a warp              |

---

## 🌍 Spawn

| Command         | Description                                |
| :-------------- | :----------------------------------------- |
| `/spawn`        | Teleports to the server spawn              |
| `/spawn help`   | Displays the Spawn help menu               |
| `/spawn set`    | Sets the server spawn                      |
| `/spawn remove` | Removes the server spawn                   |
| `/spawn tp`     | Teleports directly to the configured spawn |

---

# 🔑 Permissions

| Permission    | Description                                             |
| :------------ | :------------------------------------------------------ |
| `home.admin`  | Allows managing homes of other players.                 |
| `home.max`    | Controls the maximum number of homes a player can have. |
| `warp.admin`  | Allows creating and removing warps.                     |
| `spawn.admin` | Allows managing the server spawn.                       |

---

# 📦 Installation

### 1️⃣ Download

Download the latest version from Modrinth.

### 2️⃣ Install

Place the JAR file into your server's `plugins` folder.

### 3️⃣ Restart

Restart your Paper server.

### 4️⃣ Configure

Edit the generated configuration files to match your server.

### 5️⃣ Done!

Your server is now ready to use **TeleportCore**.
